title: EHS 102 - Environmental Health Law and Practice

items.q: Which of the following best describes Waste water treatment?
o: combining inspection, sanitation and chemical measures in one planned attack on pests
the process of cleaning used water before it is released or reused
the use of natural enemies, such as larvae-eating fish, to reduce a vector population
the liquid waste that flows out of a treatment process or works
items.s: Waste water treatment: the process of cleaning used water before it is released or reused. The other options describe Effluent, Integrated pest management, Biological control.
